packages.description: Reports the hub's cloud backup result (from the built-in cloudBackup location event) in a virtual device, readable via Maker API - works under Hub Login Security with no hub UI credentials.
packages.name: Plumcrest Cloud Backup Reporter

packages.description: Wraps the hub's internal platform-update endpoints in human-invoked commands: checkForUpdate (detect), refreshUpdateStatus, clearUpdateStatus, and an applyUpdate behind a timed, self-disarming arm (Maker API cannot arm it). Nothing is scheduled.
packages.name: Plumcrest Hub Updater
